summary: community.mysql replaced ansible.module_utils.six imports with Python 3 equivalents, making it incompatible with Python 2.7 managed hosts.
questions: Does community.mysql still support Python 2.7 hosts?

answer_card.title: community.mysql drops Python 2.7 targets
answer_card.answer_md: community.mysql replaced `ansible.module_utils.six` imports with Python 3 equivalents, so it is **no longer compatible with Python 2.7** managed hosts.
